title: Gettysburg
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office discusses Pam's false labor claims, plans a trip to Gettysburg to study war, and engages in humorous debates about history and office dynamics. The characters plan and prepare for the trip, with some conflicts and jokes about historical events and figures, culminating in the characters attempting to organize the trip and facing minor obstacles.
